segments.name: Special purpose acquisition
segments.description: A newly organized special purpose acquisition company formed to effect a business combination with one or more businesses.
segments.evidence: HCIC is a newly organized special purpose acquisition company (a "SPAC") incorporated as a Cayman Islands exempted company, on July 15, 2025, for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which is referred to throughout this Report as its initial business combination.
